title: Shesha-khanda, part 1 (portion 46)
html:
The beginning of the Shesha-khanda: the Lord sets out for the South; the brahmanas Kurma and Vasudeva at Kurma-kshetra; at Jiyada-Nrisimha the Lord tells the tale of the cowherd Punda who wounded the Boar, of the Deity rising from the earth as milk was poured, and of the merchant Jiyada, after whose name Nrisimha is called; the meeting with Ramananda Raya at Kanchi: the Lord appears to him in meditation and reveals His form of Krishna

The Lord's Journey to the South

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. Sriman Mahaprabhu, after staying some time in Puri in the bliss of kirtana together with Sarvabhauma, went to the southern lands to see Setubandha. From there, having shown mercy at Kurma-kshetra to a certain brahmana named Vasudeva and having instructed him that the dharma of the Kali age is the holy name of Sri Hari alone, He arrived at Jiyada-Nrisimha. Here, in the course of the narrative, the author relates the ancient history of Jiyada-Nrisimha. From Jiyada-Nrisimha Sriman Mahaprabhu came to Kanchi-nagara, to Ramananda, and, having shown him the form of Rasaraja and Mahabhava1, went by way of the Godavari to Panchavati; there, absorbed in prema, He saw all the places where Ramachandra had performed His various lilas during His exile in the forest, and came to Sri Ranganatha on the bank of the Kaveri. There He showed mercy to Trimalla Bhatta and spent the period of chaturmasya in his house. After that He met Paramananda Puri, the disciple of Madhavendra Puri-pada. Remembering the prophecy about the descent of Sriman Mahaprabhu [that he had heard] from the lips of Madhavendra Puri-pada, Paramananda Puri understood that the Lord was Bhagavan Himself and offered Him many hymns and prayers.

জয় নরহরি-গদাধর-প্রাণনাথ ।
কৃপা করি' কর প্রভু শুভ দৃষ্টিপাত ॥ ১ ॥

jaẏa narahari-gadādhara-prāṇanātha |
kṛpā kari' kara prabhu śubha dṛṣṭipāta || 1 ||

jaya — glory; narahari-gadadhara-prananatha — Lord of the life of Narahari and Gadadhara; kripa kari — showing mercy; kara prabhu — cast, O Lord; shubha drishtipata — an auspicious glance

1Glory to You, Lord of the life of Narahari and Gadadhara!
Be merciful, O Lord — cast on us Your auspicious glance2.

শেষখণ্ড-কথা কহি অমৃতের সার ।
শুনিতে বাঢ়য়ে সুখসাগর-পাথার ॥ ২ ॥

śeṣakhaṇḍa-kathā kahi amṛtera sāra |
śunite bāṛhaẏe sukhasāgara-pāthāra || 2 ||

sheshakhanda-katha kahi — I tell the story of the Shesha-khanda; amritera sara — the essence of nectar; shunite — in hearing; badhaye — grows; sukhasagara-pathara — a shoreless ocean of happiness

2I shall tell the story of the Shesha-khanda — the essence of nectar:
in one who hears it a shoreless ocean of happiness grows.

সার্বভৌম-ভট্টাচার্য যে করিল স্তুতি ।
কতোদিন বঞ্চিল কীর্তনে দিবারাতি ॥ ৩ ॥

sārbabhauma-bhaṭṭācārya ye karila stuti |
katodina bañcila kīrtane dibārāti || 3 ||

sarvabhauma-bhattacharya — Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya; ye karila stuti — who offered praise; katodina — some days; vanchila — spent; kirtane — in kirtana; divarati — day and night

3Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya offered praises [to the Lord],
and for some days [the Lord] spent day and night in kirtana.

সেতুবন্ধ দেখিবারে চলিলা ঠাকুর ।
কূর্মনামে বিপ্র দেখে কূর্মনামে পুর ॥ ৪ ॥

setubandha dekhibāre calilā ṭhākura |
kūrmanāme bipra dekhe kūrmanāme pura || 4 ||

setubandha dekhibare — to see Setubandha; chalila thakura — the Thakura set out; kurma-name vipra dekhe — sees a brahmana named Kurma; kurma-name pura — [in] a town named Kurma

4To see Setubandha the Thakura set out [on His way];
in a town called Kurma He sees a brahmana named Kurma3.

বাসুদেব-নামে বিপ্র আছে সেই গ্রামে ।
দুইজনা-সঙ্গে দেখা হৈল এক-ঠামে ॥ ৫ ॥

bāsudeba-nāme bipra āche sei grāme |
duijanā-saṅge dekhā haila eka-ṭhāme || 5 ||

vasudeva-name vipra — a brahmana named Vasudeva; achhe sei grame — lives in that village; duijana-sange — with both; dekha haila eka-thame — the meeting took place in one spot

5In the same village lives a brahmana named Vasudeva —
He met them both in one place.

প্রভু-দরশনে তারা হইল নির্মল ।
নিরীখয়ে গোরাদেহ প্রেমায় বিহ্বল ॥ ৬ ॥

prabhu-daraśane tārā haila nirmala |
nirīkhaẏe gorādeha premāẏa bihbala || 6 ||

prabhu-darashane — by the sight of the Lord; tara haila nirmala — they became pure; nirikhaye — gaze; gora-deha — [at] Gora's body; premaya vihvala — overwhelmed with prema

6By the sight of the Lord they became pure;
they gaze at Gora's body, overwhelmed with prema.

সুমেরু-সুন্দর তনু বাহু জানু-সম ।
সিংহগ্রীব কম্বুকণ্ঠ সুদীর্ঘ-লোচন ॥ ৭ ॥

sumeru-sundara tanu bāhu jānu-sama |
siṃhagrība kambukaṇṭha sudīrgha-locana || 7 ||

sumeru-sundara tanu — a body beautiful as Sumeru; bahu janu-sama — arms reaching the knees; simha-griva — a lion's neck; kambu-kantha — a conch-like throat; sudirgha-lochana — long eyes

7His body is beautiful as Sumeru, His arms reach to the knees,
His neck is a lion's, His throat like a conch, His eyes long.

দেখিতে দেখিতে হিয়া-আনন্দ বাড়িল ।
এই কৃষ্ণ গৌরচন্দ্র নিশ্চয় জানিল ॥ ৮ ॥

dekhite dekhite hiẏā-ānanda bāṛila |
ei kṛṣṇa gauracandra niścaẏa jānila || 8 ||

dekhite dekhite — while gazing; hiya-ananda barila — the joy of the heart increased; ei krishna gaurachandra — this Gaurachandra is Krishna; nishchaya janila — they knew for certain

8As they gazed, the joy in their hearts kept growing,
and they knew for certain: this Gaurachandra is Krishna.

হা হা মহাপ্রভু বলি' পড়িলা চরণে ।
সর্বলোক কান্দে তার প্রেমার কান্দনে ॥ ৯ ॥

hā hā mahāprabhu bali' paṛilā caraṇe |
sarbaloka kānde tāra premāra kāndane || 9 ||

ha ha mahaprabhu bali — crying "O Mahaprabhu!"; padila charane — fell at His feet; sarvaloka kande — all people weep; tara premara kandane — at their weeping of prema

9Crying "O Mahaprabhu!" they fell at His feet;
all the people weep [hearing] their weeping of prema.

তুলিয়া দোঁহারে প্রভু কৈল আলিঙ্গন ।
প্রকাশ করিল কথা মধুর বচন ॥ ১০ ॥

tuliẏā doṁhāre prabhu kaila āliṅgana |
prakāśa karila kathā madhura bacana || 10 ||

tuliya donhare — raising both; prabhu kaila alingana — the Lord embraced; prakasha karila katha — revealed speech; madhura vachana — sweet words

10Raising them both, the Lord embraced them
and revealed to them sweet words:

শুন শুন অহে দ্বিজ বচন আমার ।
কি কাজে আইলা মহী কি কর আচার ॥ ১১ ॥

śuna śuna ahe dbija bacana āmāra |
ki kāje āilā mahī ki kara ācāra || 11 ||

shuna shuna ahe dvija — listen, listen, O brahmanas; vachana amara — My word; ki kaje aila mahi — for what purpose did you come to earth; ki kara achara — what practice do you follow

11"Listen, listen, O brahmanas, to My word:
for what have you come into the world, what do you follow?

কলিযুগে ধর্ম হরিনাম-সঙ্কীর্তন ।
প্রকাশ করিল কৃষ্ণ নাম-মহাধন ॥ ১২ ॥

kaliyuge dharma harināma-saṅkīrtana |
prakāśa karila kṛṣṇa nāma-mahādhana || 12 ||

kaliyuge dharma — in the Kali age the dharma; harinama-sankirtana — the sankirtana of Hari's name; prakasha karila krishna — Krishna revealed; nama-mahadhana — the great treasure of the name

12In the Kali age the dharma is the sankirtana of Hari's name:
Krishna has revealed the great treasure of the name.

নাম-গুণ-সঙ্কীর্তনে করহ আনন্দ ।
নাচহ নাচহ লোক হউ মুক্তবন্ধ ॥ ১৩ ॥

nāma-guṇa-saṅkīrtane karaha ānanda |
nācaha nācaha loka hau muktabandha || 13 ||

nama-guna-sankirtane — in singing the names and qualities; karaha ananda — rejoice; nachaha nachaha — dance, dance; loka hau muktabandha — let people be freed from bondage

13Rejoice in singing the names and qualities [of the Lord];
dance, dance — let people be freed from bondage!"4

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু চলিলা সত্বর ।
আপনাকে আপে তারা হৈলা অগোচর ॥ ১৪ ॥

e bola baliẏā prabhu calilā satbara |
āpanāke āpe tārā hailā agocara || 14 ||

e bola baliya — saying these words; prabhu chalila satvara — the Lord went off quickly; apanake ape — to themselves; tara haila agochara — they became imperceptible (lost self-awareness)

14Having said this, the Lord quickly went away,
and they lost all awareness of themselves.

চলিতে না পারে পথে বাড়ে প্রেমরঙ্গ ।
কথোদূর গিয়া দেখে জীয়ড়-নৃসিংহ ॥ ১৫ ॥

calite nā pāre pathe bāṛe premaraṅga |
kathodūra giẏā dekhe jīẏaṛa-nṛsiṃha || 15 ||

chalite na pare pathe — cannot walk on the road; bare prema-ranga — the rapture of prema grows; katho-dura giya — going a little way; dekhe jiyada-nrisimha — sees Jiyada-Nrisimha

15He cannot walk along the road, so does the rapture of prema grow;
going on a little, He sees Jiyada-Nrisimha5.

কহিব পূর্বের কথা অপূর্ব কাহিনী ।
প্রেমায় বিহ্বল কথা কহয়ে আপনি ॥ ১৬ ॥

kahiba pūrbera kathā apūrba kāhinī |
premāẏa bihbala kathā kahaẏe āpani || 16 ||

kahiba purvera katha — I shall tell an ancient story; apurva kahini — a wondrous tale; premaya vihvala — overwhelmed with prema; katha kahaye apani — He Himself tells the story

16"I shall tell an ancient story, a wondrous tale," —
so, overwhelmed with prema, He Himself began the account.

শুন শুন সর্বলোক রহস্য আনন্দ ।
যেন মতে অবতার জীয়ড়-নৃসিংহ ॥ ১৭ ॥

śuna śuna sarbaloka rahasya ānanda |
yena mate abatāra jīẏaṛa-nṛsiṃha || 17 ||

shuna shuna sarvaloka — listen, all people; rahasya ananda — a joyful secret; yena mate — how; avatara — appeared; jiyada-nrisimha — Jiyada-Nrisimha

17"Listen, all people, to a joyful secret —
how Jiyada-Nrisimha appeared.

স্মরণ হইল মোর পূর্বের কাহিনী ।
একচিত্তে সাবধানে শুন সভে বাণী ॥ ১৮ ॥

smaraṇa haila mora pūrbera kāhinī |
ekacitte sābadhāne śuna sabhe bāṇī || 18 ||

smarana haila mora — there came to My mind; purvera kahini — an ancient tale; ekachitte savadhane — with one mind and attention; shuna sabhe bani — all of you hear the words

18An ancient tale has come to My mind;
listen, all, to My words with one-pointed attention.

এখানে আছিল এক পুঁড়্যা গোয়াল ।
কৃষিকর্ম করে পুঁড়া বিহান-বিকাল ॥ ১৯ ॥

ekhāne āchila eka puṁṛyā goẏāla |
kṛṣikarma kare puṁṛā bihāna-bikāla || 19 ||

ekhane achhila — here there lived; eka pundya goyala — a cowherd, Punda; krishikarma kare punda — Punda tills the land; bihana-bikala — morning and evening

19There lived here a cowherd [named] Punda;
Punda tilled the land from morning to evening6.

শসা-নামে খন্দ মহী কৈল উপার্জন ।
হইল মায়াম্বু খন্দ বড়ই সম্পূর্ণ ॥ ২০ ॥

śasā-nāme khanda mahī kaila upārjana |
haila māẏāmbu khanda baṛai sampūrṇa || 20 ||

shasa-name khanda — a crop called "shasa"; mahi kaila uparjana — raised on the land; haila mayambu khanda — the mayambu crop became; badai sampurna — very abundant

20On the land he raised a crop called "shasa";
the mayambu crop turned out very abundant.

দিবা-রাত্রি রাখে খন্দ নাহি অবসর ।
না জানি কখন সেই যায় নিজঘর ॥ ২১ ॥

dibā-rātri rākhe khanda nāhi abasara |
nā jāni kakhana sei yāẏa nijaghara || 21 ||

diva-ratri — day and night; rakhe khanda — guards the crop; nahi avasara — no rest; na jani kakhana — no one knows when; sei yaya nija-ghara — he goes home

21Day and night he guards the crop — he has no rest;
and no one knows when he [ever] goes home.

একদিন মনে মনে করিল বিচার ।
খন্দ রাখিবারে আমি না আসিব আর ॥ ২২ ॥

ekadina mane mane karila bicāra |
khanda rākhibāre āmi nā āsiba āra || 22 ||

ekadina — one day; mane mane — within himself; karila vichara — reflected; khanda rakhibare — to guard the crop; ami na asiba ara — I will come no more

22One day he reflected within himself:
'I will no longer come to guard the crop.'

ভাবিয়া করিল হেন কৃষ্ণে নিয়োজিব ।
তারে নিয়োজিলে আমি অন্য কাজ পাব ॥ ২২+১ ॥

bhābiẏā karila hena kṛṣṇe niẏojiba |
tāre niẏojile āmi anya kāja pāba || 22+1 ||

bhaviya karila hena — thinking, he decided thus; krishne niyojiba — I will entrust to Krishna; tare niyojile — if I entrust to Him; ami anya kaja paba — I can turn to other work

22+1Thinking it over, he decided thus: 'I will entrust [it] to Krishna;
if I entrust it to Him, I can turn to other work.'

কৃষ্ণনাম ডাকি খন্দে নিয়োজিল তারে ।
তোমার নামেতে কিছু দিব বৈষ্ণবেরে ॥ ২২+২ ॥

kṛṣṇanāma ḍāki khande niẏojila tāre |
tomāra nāmete kichu diba baiṣṇabere || 22+2 ||

krishna-nama daki — calling the name of Krishna; khande niyojila tare — entrusted the crop to Him; tomara namete — in Your name; kichhu diba vaishnavere — I will give something to the Vaishnavas

22+2Calling the name of Krishna, he entrusted the crop to Him:
'In Your name I will give something to the Vaishnavas'7.

এইমনে আছে পুঁড়া মনের হরিষে ।
আচম্বিতে দেখে খন্দ খাঞা যায় কিসে ॥ ২৩ ॥

eimane āche puṁṛā manera hariṣe |
ācambite dekhe khanda khāñā yāẏa kise || 23 ||

ei-mane achhe punda — so Punda lives; manera harishe — with a joyful mind; achambite dekhe — suddenly sees; khanda khanya yaya kise — something is eating the crop

23So Punda lives, rejoicing in his heart —
and suddenly he sees: something is eating the crop.

দেখিয়া গোয়ালা দুঃখ অনেক ভাবিলা ।
কৃষ্ণ তুমি খন্দ মোর সব নষ্ট কৈলা ॥ ২৩+১ ॥

dekhiẏā goẏālā duḥkha aneka bhābilā |
kṛṣṇa tumi khanda mora saba naṣṭa kailā || 23+1 ||

dekhiya goyala — seeing, the cowherd; duhkha aneka bhavila — grieved much; krishna tumi — Krishna, You; khanda mora saba nashta kaila — have ruined all my crop

23+1Seeing this, the cowherd grieved and thought:
'Krishna, You have ruined my whole crop!'

কান্দিয়া গোয়ালা বলে শুন নারায়ণ ।
কে মোর খাইল খন্দ দেখিব নয়নে ॥ ২৩+২ ॥

kāndiẏā goẏālā bale śuna nārāẏaṇa |
ke mora khāila khanda dekhiba naẏane || 23+2 ||

kandiya goyala bale — weeping, the cowherd says; shuna narayana — listen, Narayana; ke mora khaila khanda — who ate my crop; dekhiba nayane — I will see with my eyes

23+2Weeping, the cowherd said: 'Listen, Narayana!
Who has eaten my crop — I will see with my own eyes.'

ইহা বলি কুঁড়েতে আশ্রয় করি রহে ।
জাগিয়া রহিল সেই খন্দ মহামোহে ॥ ২৩+৩ ॥

ihā bali kuṁṛete āśraẏa kari rahe |
jāgiẏā rahila sei khanda mahāmohe || 23+3 ||

iha bali — saying this; kundete ashraya kari rahe — takes shelter in a hut; jagiya rahila sei — he stayed awake; khanda — [guarding] the crop; maha-mohe — in great distress

23+3Saying this, he took shelter in a hut
and stayed awake, guarding the crop, in great distress8.

আরদিন রাত্রি জাগে তৃতীয় প্রহর ।
আচম্বিতে আইল এক বরাহ ডাগর ॥ ২৪ ॥

āradina rātri jāge tṛtīẏa prahara |
ācambite āila eka barāha ḍāgara || 24 ||

ara-dina ratri jage — the next night he keeps awake; tritiya prahara — in the third watch; achambite aila — suddenly came; eka baraha dagara — a huge boar

24The next night he keeps watch — and in the third watch
suddenly there came a huge boar.

দেখিয়া গোয়ালা সেই হৈল সাবধান ।
খন্দ খায় বরাহ সে সারে দুই কাণ ॥ ২৫ ॥

dekhiẏā goẏālā sei haila sābadhāna |
khanda khāẏa barāha se sāre dui kāṇa || 25 ||

dekhiya goyala sei — seeing, that cowherd; haila savadhana — was on guard; khanda khaya baraha se — the boar eats the crop; sare dui kana — twitches its two ears

25Seeing it, the cowherd was on his guard:
the boar eats the crop, twitching its ears.

খন্দ খায় লতা ছিঁড়ে আপনার সুখে ।
দেখিয়া গোয়ালা গুণ দিলেক ধনুকে ॥ ২৬ ॥

khanda khāẏa latā chiṁṛe āpanāra sukhe |
dekhiẏā goẏālā guṇa dileka dhanuke || 26 ||

khanda khaya — eats the crop; lata chhinde — tears the vines; apanara sukhe — at its pleasure; dekhiya goyala — seeing, the cowherd; guna dileka dhanuke — strung the bow

26It eats the crop, tears the vines to its heart's content —
seeing this, the cowherd strung his bow:

খন্দ খাও লতা ছিঁড় সার দুই কাণ ।
আজি মোর হাতে তুমি হারাবে পরাণ ॥ ২৭ ॥

khanda khāo latā chiṁṛa sāra dui kāṇa |
āji mora hāte tumi hārābe parāṇa || 27 ||

khanda khao — eat the crop; lata chhinda — tear the vines; sara dui kana — twitch your ears; aji mora hate — today at my hand; tumi harabe parana — you will lose your life

27'Eat the crop, tear the vines, twitch your ears —
today at my hand you shall lose your life!'

ইহা বলি' সন্ধান পূরিয়া এড়ে বাণ ।
নির্ভরে বাজিল বরাহ স্মরে রামনাম ॥ ২৮ ॥

ihā bali' sandhāna pūriẏā eṛe bāṇa |
nirbhare bājila barāha smare rāmanāma || 28 ||

iha bali — saying this; sandhana puriya — taking aim; ere bana — looses the arrow; nirbhare bajila — it struck deep; baraha smare rama-nama — the boar utters the name of Rama

28Saying this, he took aim and loosed the arrow;
it struck deep — the boar utters the name of Rama9.

ধাঞা সান্ধাইল পর্বত-গুহার ভিতরে ।
দেখিয়া গোয়ালা পুঁড়া পড়িল ফাঁপরে ॥ ২৯ ॥

dhāñā sāndhāila parbata-guhāra bhitare |
dekhiẏā goẏālā puṁṛā paṛila phāṁpare || 29 ||

dhanya sandhaila — running, it slipped; parvata-guhara bhitare — into a mountain cave; dekhiya — seeing; goyala punda — Punda the cowherd; parila phapare — was bewildered

29Running off, it hid inside a mountain cave;
seeing this, Punda the cowherd was bewildered:

বরাহ হইয়া কেনে স্মরে রাম রাম ।
বরাহ না হয় এই সেই ভগবান্ ॥ ৩০ ॥

barāha haiẏā kene smare rāma rāma |
barāha nā haẏa ei sei bhagabān || 30 ||

baraha haiya — being a boar; kene smare rama rama — why does it utter "Rama, Rama"; baraha na haya ei — this is not a boar; sei bhagavan — it is Bhagavan

30'It is a boar — why then does it repeat "Rama, Rama"?
This is no boar — this is Bhagavan Himself!'

এতেক চিন্তিয়া পুঁড়া কাতর-অন্তর ।
গহ্বর-নিকটে যাঞা কহিছে উত্তর ॥ ৩১ ॥

eteka cintiẏā puṁṛā kātara-antara |
gahbara-nikaṭe yāñā kahiche uttara || 31 ||

eteka chintiya — thinking thus; punda katara-antara — Punda, pained at heart; gahvara-nikate yanya — going near the cave; kahichhe uttara — calls out for an answer

31Thinking so, Punda, pained at heart,
went up to the cave and calls out [for] an answer.

কে তুমি কে তুমি বোলে উত্তর না পায় ।
তিন উপবাস কৈল কাতর-হিয়ায় ॥ ৩২ ॥

ke tumi ke tumi bole uttara nā pāẏa |
tina upabāsa kaila kātara-hiẏāẏa || 32 ||

ke tumi ke tumi bole — says "Who are You? Who are You?"; uttara na paya — gets no answer; tina upavasa kaila — fasted three days; katara-hiyaya — with an anguished heart

32'Who are You? Who are You?' he says, but gets no answer;
with an anguished heart he fasted three days:

কি কাজ করিনু আমি অধম-দুরন্ত ।
মো-সম পাতকী নাহি পামর-পাষণ্ড ॥ ৩৩ ॥

ki kāja karinu āmi adhama-duranta |
mo-sama pātakī nāhi pāmara-pāṣaṇḍa || 33 ||

ki kaja karinu ami — what have I done; adhama-duranta — low wretch; mo-sama pataki nahi — there is no sinner like me; pamara-pashanda — a vile unbeliever

33'What have I done, low wretch that I am!
There is no sinner like me — a vile unbeliever.'

দয়া উপজিল প্রভু করুণা-নিধান ।
আকাশ-কথায় কহে আমি ভগবান ॥ ৩৪ ॥

daẏā upajila prabhu karuṇā-nidhāna |
ākāśa-kathāẏa kahe āmi bhagabāna || 34 ||

daya upajila — mercy arose; prabhu karuna-nidhana — [in] the Lord, treasury of compassion; akasha-kathaya kahe — says with a voice from the sky; ami bhagavana — I am Bhagavan

34Mercy arose in the Lord, the treasury of compassion;
with a voice from the sky He says: 'I am Bhagavan.

আমারে মারিলি তোর কৈল অপচয় ।
চিন্তা না করিহ যাহ আপন আলয় ॥ ৩৫ ॥

āmāre mārili tora kaila apacaẏa |
cintā nā kariha yāha āpana ālaẏa || 35 ||

amare marili — you struck Me; tora kaila apachaya — [I] caused you loss; chinta na kariha — do not worry; yaha apana alaya — go to your home

35You wounded Me, and I ruined you —
do not worry, go to your home'10.

এ বোল শুনিঞা পুঁড়া অধিক কাতর ।
উপবাসে উপবাসে দিমু কলেবর ॥ ৩৬ ॥

e bola śuniñā puṁṛā adhika kātara |
upabāse upabāse dimu kalebara || 36 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; punda adhika katara — Punda is more distressed; upavase upavase — fasting and fasting; dimu kalebara — I will give up the body

36Hearing this, Punda was tormented still more:
'Fasting day after day, I will give up this body.'

এইমনে উপবাস করিল অনেক ।
আচম্বিতে গগনে উঠিল ধ্বনি এক ॥ ৩৭ ॥

eimane upabāsa karila aneka |
ācambite gagane uṭhila dhbani eka || 37 ||

ei-mane — thus; upavasa karila aneka — fasted much; achambite — suddenly; gagane uthila dhvani eka — a voice arose in the sky

37So he fasted many days;
suddenly a voice arose in the sky:

কেনে রে অবোধ পুঁড়া মর অকারণ ।
অপরাধ নাহি যাহ আপন ভবন ॥ ৩৮ ॥

kene re abodha puṁṛā mara akāraṇa |
aparādha nāhi yāha āpana bhabana || 38 ||

kene re abodha punda — why, foolish Punda; mara akarana — do you die without cause; aparadha nahi — there is no fault; yaha apana bhavana — go to your home

38'Why, foolish Punda, do you die for no reason?
There is no fault [in you] — go to your home.'

পুনরপি বোলে পুঁড়া কাতর-বচনে ।
তোমারে মারিলুঁ বাণ কি কাজ জীবনে ॥ ৩৯ ॥

punarapi bole puṁṛā kātara-bacane |
tomāre māriluṁ bāṇa ki kāja jībane || 39 ||

punarapi bole punda — again Punda says; katara-vachane — in a pained voice; tomare marilun bana — I shot an arrow at You; ki kaja jivane — what use is life

39Again Punda speaks in a voice full of pain:
'I shot an arrow at You — what use is my life?

মরিলেহ নাহি ঘুচে এ দোষ আমার ।
এ দোষের উচিত হবে যমের প্রহার ॥ ৪০ ॥

marileha nāhi ghuce e doṣa āmāra |
e doṣera ucita habe yamera prahāra || 40 ||

marileha — even if I die; nahi ghuche e dosha amara — this sin of mine is not removed; e doshera uchita habe — fitting for this sin is; yamera prahara — Yama's punishment

40Even if I die, this sin of mine will not be washed away;
for such a sin the punishment of Yama is my due.

শুদ্ধ হইব আর আমি কোন্ প্রতিকারে ।
সবে আমি মাত্র বাণ মারিল তোমারে ॥ ৪১ ॥

śuddha haiba āra āmi kon pratikāre |
sabe āmi mātra bāṇa mārila tomāre || 41 ||

shuddha haiba ara ami — shall I be purified; kon pratikare — by what remedy; sabe ami matra — it was I alone; bana marila tomare — who shot an arrow at You

41By what atonement shall I be purified?
For it was I who shot an arrow at You!

এ কোমল গায়ে তোর ব্যথা এত দিল ।
ধিক্ ধিক্ প্রাণ মোর তোমারে মারিল ॥ ৪১+১ ॥

e komala gāẏe tora byathā eta dila |
dhik dhik prāṇa mora tomāre mārila || 41+1 ||

e komala gaye tora — to Your tender body; byatha eta dila — gave so much pain; dhik dhik prana mora — shame on my life; tomare marila — it wounded You

41+1On Your tender body I inflicted such pain —
shame, shame on my life: I wounded You!

মোর পিতৃলোক প্রভু গেল নরকেরে ।
আর লোক নরকে যাবে যে দেখিবে মোরে ॥ ৪১+২ ॥

mora pitṛloka prabhu gela narakere |
āra loka narake yābe ye dekhibe more || 41+2 ||

mora pitriloka — my forefathers; prabhu — O Lord; gela narakere — went to hell; ara loka narake yabe — and people will go to hell; ye dekhibe more — who see me

41+2My forefathers, Lord, have gone to hell,
and those who see me will go to hell'11.

এ বোল শুনিঞা বাণী আইল আরবার ।
নাহি অপরাধ তুষ্ট হইল অপার ॥ ৪২ ॥

e bola śuniñā bāṇī āila ārabāra |
nāhi aparādha tuṣṭa haila apāra || 42 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; bani aila arabara — the voice came again; nahi aparadha — there is no fault; tushta haila apara — [I] am boundlessly pleased

42Hearing this, the voice came again:
'There is no fault — I am boundlessly pleased.

পূর্বজন্মে যত অপরাধ কৈলে তুমি ।
একই কালে তোর পাপ সব লৈলুঁ আমি ॥ ৪২+১ ॥

pūrbajanme yata aparādha kaile tumi |
ekai kāle tora pāpa saba lailuṁ āmi || 42+1 ||

purvajanme — in former births; yata aparadha kaile tumi — all the offences you committed; ekai kale — at once; tora papa saba lailun ami — I have taken all your sins

42+1All the offences you committed in former births —
all your sins I have taken on Myself at once.

তোর দেহ মোর দেহ জানিহ সর্বথা ।
নিশ্চয় আমারে তুমি নাহি দাও ব্যথা ॥ ৪২+২ ॥

tora deha mora deha jāniha sarbathā |
niścaẏa āmāre tumi nāhi dāo byathā || 42+2 ||

tora deha mora deha — your body is My body; janiha sarvatha — know in every way; nishchaya — truly; amare tumi nahi dao byatha — you have given Me no pain

42+2Know: your body is My body, in every way;
truly, you have caused Me no pain'12.

এ বোল শুনিঞা পুঁড়া কহে কর জুড়ি' ।
তোমার আজ্ঞায় মুঞি বোলোঁ ভয় ছাড়ি' ॥ ৪৩ ॥

e bola śuniñā puṁṛā kahe kara juṛi' |
tomāra ājñāẏa muñi boloṁ bhaẏa chāṛi' || 43 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; punda kahe kara juri — Punda says with joined palms; tomara ajnaya — by Your command; munyi bolon — I speak; bhaya chhari — setting fear aside

43Hearing this, Punda speaks with joined palms:
'By Your command I speak, setting fear aside:

কেমনে জানিব মোর ঘুচিল এ দোষ ।
পরসাদ সাক্ষী পাইলে হঙ মো সন্তোষ ॥ ৪৪ ॥

kemane jāniba mora ghucila e doṣa |
parasāda sākṣī pāile haṅa mo santoṣa || 44 ||

kemane janiba — how shall I know; mora ghuchila e dosha — that this sin of mine is removed; parasada sakshi paile — if I get grace and a witness; hanga mo santosha — I shall be content

44how shall I know that this sin of mine is washed away?
If I receive grace and a witness, I shall be content.

এ কথা কহিব আমি রাজার গোচরে ।
এইমত আজ্ঞা তুমি কহিবে তাহারে ॥ ৪৫ ॥

e kathā kahiba āmi rājāra gocare |
eimata ājñā tumi kahibe tāhāre || 45 ||

e katha kahiba ami — this I will tell; rajara gochare — to the king; ei-mata ajna — the same command; tumi kahibe tahare — You will tell him

45I will tell this to the king —
give him too the same command.

তবে সে প্রতীত মুঞি পাঙ হিয়া-সাক্ষী ।
সর্বজন জানে তুমি হৈলে মোরে সুখী ॥ ৪৬ ॥

tabe se pratīta muñi pāṅa hiẏā-sākṣī |
sarbajana jāne tumi haile more sukhī || 46 ||

tabe se pratita — then [there will be] belief; munyi panga hiya-sakshi — I get a witness for the heart; sarvajana jane — all people know; tumi haile more sukhi — You have made me happy

46Then I shall believe, having a witness for my heart,
and all people will know that You have made me happy.'

তবে পুনরপি আজ্ঞা করিলা ঈশ্বর ।
যে বলিলা সেই হবে পাইলে তুমি বর ॥ ৪৭ ॥

tabe punarapi ājñā karilā īśbara |
ye balilā sei habe pāile tumi bara || 47 ||

tabe punarapi — then again; ajna karila ishvara — the Lord commanded; ye balila sei habe — what you said will be; paile tumi bara — you have obtained the boon

47Then the Lord commanded again:
'As you have said, so it shall be: you have received the boon.'

এ বোল শুনিঞা পুঁড়া হরষিত হঞা ।
মহাবেগে রাজদ্বারে উত্তরিল গিয়া ॥ ৪৮ ॥

e bola śuniñā puṁṛā haraṣita hañā |
mahābege rājadbāre uttarila giẏā || 48 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; punda harashita hanya — Punda, rejoicing; maha-vege — with great speed; raja-dvare uttarila giya — arrived at the king's gate

48Hearing this, Punda rejoiced
and in great haste came to the king's gate.

দ্বারীকে কহিল আরে শুন দ্বারিবর ।
যে কিছু কহিয়ে রাজার করহ গোচর ॥ ৪৯ ॥

dbārīke kahila āre śuna dbāribara |
ye kichu kahiẏe rājāra karaha gocara || 49 ||

dvarike kahila — said to the gatekeeper; are shuna dvarivara — hey, listen, best of gatekeepers; ye kichhu kahiye — whatever I say; rajara karaha gochara — bring to the king's notice

49He said to the gatekeeper: 'Listen, best of gatekeepers!
Bring to the king's notice all that I shall say.

কহিব অপূর্ব কথা লোকে অবিদিত ।
শুনিঞা আমারে রাজা করিবে পীরিত ॥ ৫০ ॥

kahiba apūrba kathā loke abidita |
śuniñā āmāre rājā karibe pīrita || 50 ||

kahiba apurva katha — I will tell a wondrous thing; loke avidita — unknown to people; shuninya — hearing; amare raja karibe pirita — the king will love me

50I shall tell of a wondrous thing, unknown to people;
hearing it, the king will love me.'

এ বোল শুনিঞা দ্বারী রাজারে কহিল ।
রাজার আজ্ঞায় পুঁড়া গোচর হইল ॥ ৫১ ॥

e bola śuniñā dbārī rājāre kahila |
rājāra ājñāẏa puṁṛā gocara haila || 51 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; dvari rajare kahila — the gatekeeper told the king; rajara ajnaya — by the king's command; punda gochara haila — Punda came before him

51Hearing this, the gatekeeper told the king,
and at the king's command Punda came before [him].

দণ্ডবত করি' কহে সব বিবরণ ।
আদ্যোপান্ত যত কথা কৈল নিবেদন ॥ ৫২ ॥

daṇḍabata kari' kahe saba bibaraṇa |
ādyopānta yata kathā kaila nibedana || 52 ||

dandavata kari — prostrating; kahe saba vivarana — tells all in detail; adyopanta — from beginning to end; yata katha kaila nivedana — related everything

52Falling down like a staff, he tells everything in detail —
he related everything from beginning to end.

শুনিঞা ত মহারাজে বিস্ময় লাগিল ।
নিশ্চয় করিয়া কহ পুঁড়াকে কহিল ॥ ৫৩ ॥

śuniñā ta mahārāje bismaẏa lāgila |
niścaẏa kariẏā kaha puṁṛāke kahila || 53 ||

shuninya ta — hearing; maharaje vismaya lagila — the maharaja was amazed; nishchaya kariya kaha — tell it for certain; pundake kahila — he said to Punda

53Hearing it, the maharaja was amazed
and said to Punda: 'Tell it for certain.'

পুনরপি কহে পুঁড়া করিয়া নিশ্চয় ।
সেইখানে চল রাজা ঘুচাও বিস্ময় ॥ ৫৪ ॥

punarapi kahe puṁṛā kariẏā niścaẏa |
seikhāne cala rājā ghucāo bismaẏa || 54 ||

punarapi kahe punda — again Punda says; kariya nishchaya — with certainty; seikhane chala raja — come there, O king; ghuchao vismaya — dispel your amazement

54Again Punda speaks with certainty:
'Come there, O king — dispel your amazement.

আমারে যেমত আজ্ঞা করিলা ঠাকুর ।
সেইমত আজ্ঞা তুমি পাইবে অদূর ॥ ৫৫ ॥

āmāre yemata ājñā karilā ṭhākura |
seimata ājñā tumi pāibe adūra || 55 ||

amare yemata — as to me; ajna karila thakura — the Thakura commanded; sei-mata ajna — the same command; tumi paibe adura — you will soon receive

55As the Thakura commanded me,
the same command you too will soon receive.'

রাজা বোলে আজ্ঞা যদি করয়ে ঈশ্বর ।
আজন্ম হইব আমি তোমার নফর ॥ ৫৬ ॥

rājā bole ājñā yadi karaẏe īśbara |
ājanma haiba āmi tomāra naphara || 56 ||

raja bole — the king says; ajna yadi karaye ishvara — if Ishvara commands; ajanma haiba ami — for life I shall be; tomara naphara — your servant

56The king says: 'If Ishvara commands,
for life I shall be your servant.'

এ বোল বলিয়া রাজা চলিলা সত্বর ।
পদব্রজে গেলা যথা পর্বত-গহ্বর ॥ ৫৭ ॥

e bola baliẏā rājā calilā satbara |
padabraje gelā yathā parbata-gahbara || 57 ||

e bola baliya — saying this; raja chalila satvara — the king went quickly; padavraje gela — went on foot; yatha parvata-gahvara — to where the mountain cave was

57Saying this, the king set out in haste,
on foot he went to where the mountain cave was.

পর্বত-গহ্বর-দ্বারে এক-মন-চিতে ।
বিস্তর মিনতি করে লোটাঞা ভূমিতে ॥ ৫৮ ॥

parbata-gahbara-dbāre eka-mana-cite |
bistara minati kare loṭāñā bhūmite || 58 ||

parvata-gahvara-dvare — at the mouth of the mountain cave; eka-mana-chite — with one-pointed heart; vistara minati kare — prays at length; lotanya bhumite — rolling on the ground

58At the mouth of the mountain cave, with all his heart,
he prays at length, rolling on the ground.

দ্রবিলা ঠাকুর আজ্ঞা উঠিল গগনে ।
মিথ্যা নহে শুন রাজা পুঁড়ার বচনে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

drabilā ṭhākura ājñā uṭhila gagane |
mithyā nahe śuna rājā puṁṛāra bacane || 59 ||

dravila thakura — the Thakura melted; ajna uthila gagane — a command arose in the sky; mithya nahe — not false; shuna raja — listen, O king; pundara vachane — are Punda's words

59The Thakura relented — a command arose in the sky:
'Not false, O king, listen, are Punda's words.

তুমি সাক্ষী হৈলে পুঁড়া হইল আমার ।
ইহারে সে নাহি আর যম-অধিকার ॥ ৫৯+১ ॥

tumi sākṣī haile puṁṛā haila āmāra |
ihāre se nāhi āra yama-adhikāra || 59+1 ||

tumi sakshi haile — you have become witness; punda haila amara — Punda has become Mine; ihare se nahi ara — over him there is no more; yama-adhikara — the power of Yama

59+1You are the witness: Punda has become Mine;
over him Yama has power no more.'

এ বোল শুনিয়া রাজা নাচয়ে আনন্দে ।
গোয়ালার চরণ ধরিয়া পড়ি' কান্দে ॥ ৫৯+২ ॥

e bola śuniẏā rājā nācaẏe ānande |
goẏālāra caraṇa dhariẏā paṛi' kānde || 59+2 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing this; raja nachaye anande — the king dances with joy; goyalara charana dhariya — clasping the cowherd's feet; pari kande — falling down, weeps

59+2Hearing this, the king dances with joy,
clasping the cowherd's feet, he weeps:

তুমি মোর গুরু হৈয়া কৃষ্ণ মিলাইলা ।
কৃষ্ণের শ্রীমুখ-কথা তুমি শুনাইলা ॥ ৫৯+৩ ॥

tumi mora guru haiẏā kṛṣṇa milāilā |
kṛṣṇera śrīmukha-kathā tumi śunāilā || 59+3 ||

tumi mora guru haiya — you, becoming my guru; krishna milaila — united [me] with Krishna; krishnera shrimukha-katha — words from Krishna's lips; tumi shunaila — you let [me] hear

59+3'You have become my guru and united me with Krishna,
you have let me hear words from Krishna's own lips!'

গোয়ালার পায়ে পড়ে রাণীগণ সঙ্গে ।
দেখিয়া কৃষ্ণের দয়া উপজিল অঙ্গে ॥ ৫৯+৪ ॥

goẏālāra pāẏe paṛe rāṇīgaṇa saṅge |
dekhiẏā kṛṣṇera daẏā upajila aṅge || 59+4 ||

goyalara paye pare — falls at the cowherd's feet; ranigana sange — with the queens; dekhiya — seeing; krishnera daya upajila ange — mercy arose in Krishna

59+4Together with the queens [the king] falls at the cowherd's feet;
seeing this, Krishna was filled with mercy:

মোর ভক্তে জাতি-বুদ্ধি না করিলে তুমি ।
তোরে দেখা দিব রাজা কহিলা ত আমি ॥ ৫৯+৫ ॥

mora bhakte jāti-buddhi nā karile tumi |
tore dekhā diba rājā kahilā ta āmi || 59+5 ||

mora bhakte — toward My devotee; jati-buddhi na karile tumi — you did not think in terms of caste; tore dekha diba — I will appear to you; raja — O king; kahila ta ami — I said

59+5'You did not judge My devotee by caste —
therefore, O king, I said that I would appear to you13.

দুগ্ধসেচন তুমি কর এইস্থানে ।
দুগ্ধের সেচনে আমা পাবে বিদ্যমানে ॥ ৬০ ॥

dugdhasecana tumi kara eisthāne |
dugdhera secane āmā pābe bidyamāne || 60 ||

dugdha-sechana tumi kara — pour milk; ei-sthane — on this place; dugdhera sechane — by the pouring of milk; ama pabe vidyamane — you will find Me before you

60Pour milk on this place:
by the pouring of milk you will see Me before your eyes.'

এ বোল শুনিঞা রাজা হরষিত চিতে ।
ঘোষণা পড়িল রাজ্যে দুগ্ধ যে আনিতে ॥ ৬১ ॥

e bola śuniñā rājā haraṣita cite |
ghoṣaṇā paṛila rājye dugdha ye ānite || 61 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; raja harashita chite — the king with a joyful heart; ghoshana parila rajye — a proclamation went through the kingdom; dugdha ye anite — to bring milk

61Hearing this, the king, with a joyful heart,
had it proclaimed through the kingdom that milk be brought.

প্রভুর আজ্ঞায় দুগ্ধ ঢালে সেইখানে ।
আচম্বিতে মাথার চূড়া দেখে বিদ্যমানে ॥ ৬২ ॥

prabhura ājñāẏa dugdha ḍhāle seikhāne |
ācambite māthāra cūṛā dekhe bidyamāne || 62 ||

prabhura ajnaya — by the Lord's command; dugdha dhale seikhane — they pour milk there; achambite — suddenly; mathara chura — the crown of the head; dekhe vidyamane — they see before them

62By the Lord's command they pour milk there —
and suddenly they see before their eyes the crown of a head.

নানাবিধ বাদ্য বাজে আনন্দ অপার ।
আনন্দে ভাসয়ে সুখসাগর-পাথার ॥ ৬৩ ॥

nānābidha bādya bāje ānanda apāra |
ānande bhāsaẏe sukhasāgara-pāthāra || 63 ||

nanavidha badya baje — many kinds of instruments sound; ananda apara — boundless joy; anande bhasaye — they float in joy; sukhasagara-pathara — [in] a shoreless ocean of happiness

63All kinds of instruments play, the joy is boundless;
[all] float in joy — in a shoreless ocean of happiness.

হরি হরি বোল শুনি' চৌদিগ ভরিয়া ।
নাচয়ে সকল লোক দুবাহু তুলিয়া ॥ ৬৪ ॥

hari hari bola śuni' caudiga bhariẏā |
nācaẏe sakala loka dubāhu tuliẏā || 64 ||

hari hari bola shuni — hearing "Hari, Hari!"; chaudiga bhariya — filling all directions; nachaye sakala loka — all people dance; dubahu tuliya — raising both arms

64On every side resounds "Hari! Hari!" —
all the people dance with both arms raised.

যত দুগ্ধ ঢালে তত উঠয়ে শরীর ।
উঠয়ে শরীর দেখে এ নাভি গভীর ॥ ৬৫ ॥

yata dugdha ḍhāle tata uṭhaẏe śarīra |
uṭhaẏe śarīra dekhe e nābhi gabhīra || 65 ||

yata dugdha dhale — as much milk as they pour; tata uthaye sharira — so far the body rises; uthaye sharira — the body rises; dekhe e nabhi gabhira — they see the deep navel

65As much milk as they pour — so far the body rises;
the body rises — the deep [hollow of the] navel is seen.

অধিক ঢালয়ে দুগ্ধ মনের হরিষে ।
প্রভু-সব-অবয়ব দেখিবার আশে ॥ ৬৬ ॥

adhika ḍhālaẏe dugdha manera hariṣe |
prabhu-saba-abaẏaba dekhibāra āśe || 66 ||

adhika dhalaye dugdha — they pour more milk; manera harishe — with joyful minds; prabhu-saba-avayava — all the Lord's limbs; dekhibara ashe — hoping to see

66With joyful hearts they pour still more milk,
hoping to see all the limbs of the Lord.

উঠিল শরীর জানু দেখে বিদ্যমান ।
না ঢালিহ দুগ্ধ আজ্ঞা ভেল পরিমাণ ॥ ৬৭ ॥

uṭhila śarīra jānu dekhe bidyamāna |
nā ḍhāliha dugdha ājñā bhela parimāṇa || 67 ||

uthila sharira — the body rose; janu dekhe vidyamana — they see the knees before them; na dhaliha dugdha — pour no milk; ajna — [was] the command; bhela parimana — the measure is reached

67The body rose — the knees are seen before their eyes.
'Pour no milk' — was the command: the measure is reached.

বহুত ঢালয়ে দুগ্ধ মনের হরিষে ।
পদতল দুইখানি না উঠিল শেষে ॥ ৬৮ ॥

bahuta ḍhālaẏe dugdha manera hariṣe |
padatala duikhāni nā uṭhila śeṣe || 68 ||

bahuta dhalaye dugdha — they pour much milk; manera harishe — with joyful minds; padatala duikhani — both soles; na uthila sheshe — did not rise in the end

68Yet with joyful hearts they pour much more milk —
but the soles of the feet did not rise in the end.

হেনকালে আজ্ঞাবাণী উঠিল গগনে ।
না উঠিব পদ আর না করো যতনে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

henakāle ājñābāṇī uṭhila gagane |
nā uṭhiba pada āra nā karo yatane || 69 ||

henakale — then; ajna-bani uthila gagane — a voice of command arose in the sky; na uthiba pada — the feet will not rise; ara na karo yatane — strive no more

69Then a command arose in the sky:
'The feet will not rise — strive no more'14.

এ বোল শুনিঞা রাজা হরিষ-বিষাদ ।
মহামহোৎসব করে পাঞা পরসাদ ॥ ৭০ ॥

e bola śuniñā rājā hariṣa-biṣāda |
mahāmahotsaba kare pāñā parasāda || 70 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; raja harisha-vishada — the king [in] joy and sorrow; maha-mahotsava kare — hold a great festival; panya parasada — having received grace

70Hearing this, the king [felt] both joy and sorrow;
having received grace, all hold a great festival.

দেউল-মন্দির দিল নানা ভোগ-রাগ ।
দু-নয়ান ভরি' দেখে হিয়া অনুরাগ ॥ ৭১ ॥

deula-mandira dila nānā bhoga-rāga |
du-naẏāna bhari' dekhe hiẏā anurāga || 71 ||

deula-mandira dila — built a temple; nana bhoga-raga — various offerings; du-nayana bhari dekhe — they gaze with full eyes; hiya anuraga — the heart full of love

71He raised a temple and established various offerings;
[all] gaze and cannot gaze enough, their hearts full of love.

পুঁড়ারে কহিল রাজা বিনয় করিয়া ।
তুমি রাজ্যের রাজা হও মোরে কৃপা দিয়া ॥ ৭১+১ ॥

puṁṛāre kahila rājā binaẏa kariẏā |
tumi rājyera rājā hao more kṛpā diẏā || 71+1 ||

pundare kahila raja — the king said to Punda; vinaya kariya — humbly; tumi rajyera raja hao — be you king of the kingdom; more kripa diya — showing me mercy

71+1The king humbly said to Punda:
'Be king of this kingdom — show me mercy.'

গোপ বলে অজ্ঞান হইয়া বল কথা ।
রাজ্য নাহি লব মোরে কেন দেহ ব্যথা ॥ ৭১+২ ॥

gopa bale ajñāna haiẏā bala kathā |
rājya nāhi laba more kena deha byathā || 71+2 ||

gopa bale — the cowherd says; ajnana haiya bala katha — you speak like an ignorant man; rajya nahi laba — I will not take the kingdom; more kena deha byatha — why do you pain me

71+2The cowherd answers: 'You speak like an ignorant man:
I will not take the kingdom — why do you pain me?

তোতে মোতে কৃষ্ণসেবা করিব আনন্দে ।
কোন্ সুখ রাজ্যে রাজা ছাড়িয়া গোবিন্দে ॥ ৭১+৩ ॥

tote mote kṛṣṇasebā kariba ānande |
kon sukha rājye rājā chāṛiẏā gobinde || 71+3 ||

tote mote — you and I; krishna-seva kariba anande — will joyfully serve Krishna; kon sukha rajye — what happiness in a kingdom; raja — O king; chhariya govinde — leaving Govinda

71+3You and I together will joyfully serve Krishna;
what happiness is there in a kingdom, O king, if one leaves Govinda?'

শুনি রাজা বিনয়ে বলিল কর জুড়ি ।
তুমি আমি সেবার হইব অধিকারী ॥ ৭১+৪ ॥

śuni rājā binaẏe balila kara juṛi |
tumi āmi sebāra haiba adhikārī || 71+4 ||

shuni raja — hearing, the king; vinaye balila kara juri — humbly said with joined palms; tumi ami — you and I; sevara haiba adhikari — will be entitled to the service

71+4Hearing this, the king humbly said with joined palms:
'You and I — we shall both be entitled to the service'15.

এইমনে আছে রাজা আনন্দিত-চিতে ।
ডিঙ্গা লঞা এক সাধু আইলা আচম্বিতে ॥ ৭২ ॥

eimane āche rājā ānandita-cite |
ḍiṅgā lañā eka sādhu āilā ācambite || 72 ||

ei-mane achhe raja — so the king lives; anandita-chite — with a joyful heart; dinga lanya — with a boat; eka sadhu aila achambite — suddenly a merchant came

72So the king lives with a joyful heart;
suddenly a merchant came in a boat.

তার সঙ্গে দুই স্ত্রী পরমা সুন্দরী ।
সঙ্গে যাইবারে চাহে দেখিতে শ্রীহরি ॥ ৭২+১ ॥

tāra saṅge dui strī paramā sundarī |
saṅge yāibāre cāhe dekhite śrīhari || 72+1 ||

tara sange — with him; dui stri — two wives; parama sundari — most beautiful; sange yaibare chahe — want to go along; dekhite shrihari — to see Sri Hari

72+1With him were two wives, most beautiful;
they want to go with him to see Sri Hari.

সাধু নাহি লয় সঙ্গে লজ্জার কারণে ।
দুই স্ত্রী কান্দে ধরি সাধুর চরণে ॥ ৭২+২ ॥

sādhu nāhi laẏa saṅge lajjāra kāraṇe |
dui strī kānde dhari sādhura caraṇe || 72+2 ||

sadhu nahi laya sange — the merchant does not take [them] along; lajjara karane — out of shame; dui stri kande — the two wives weep; dhari sadhura charane — clasping the merchant's feet

72+2The merchant will not take them along — he is ashamed;
both wives weep, clasping the merchant's feet:

তুমি গুরু সঙ্গে করি কৃষ্ণেরে দেখাও ।
মো দোঁহার ভাগ্য নাথ তুমি না ঘুচাও ॥ ৭২+৩ ॥

tumi guru saṅge kari kṛṣṇere dekhāo |
mo doṁhāra bhāgya nātha tumi nā ghucāo || 72+3 ||

tumi guru — you are the guru; sange kari — taking [us] along; krishnere dekhao — show [us] Krishna; mo donhara bhagya — the fortune of us two; natha — lord; tumi na ghuchao — do not destroy

72+3'You are [our] guru — take us with you, show us Krishna,
do not, lord, destroy our good fortune.'

সাধু বলে সঙ্গে নাহি লব তো সবারে ।
প্রসাদ আনিব আমি তোরা থাক ঘরে ॥ ৭২+৪ ॥

sādhu bale saṅge nāhi laba to sabāre |
prasāda āniba āmi torā thāka ghare || 72+4 ||

sadhu bale — the merchant says; sange nahi laba to sabare — I will not take you along; prasada aniba ami — I will bring prasada; tora thaka ghare — stay at home

72+4The merchant says: 'I will not take you with me;
I will bring prasada — stay at home.'

তারা বলে তুমি যে কহিলে সেই হয় ।
কৃষ্ণ দেখিবারে সাধ হৈয়াছে নিশ্চয় ॥ ৭২+৫ ॥

tārā bale tumi ye kahile sei haẏa |
kṛṣṇa dekhibāre sādha haiẏāche niścaẏa || 72+5 ||

tara bale — they say; tumi ye kahile — what you have said; sei haya — so be it; krishna dekhibare sadha — the desire to see Krishna; haiyachhe nishchaya — has surely arisen

72+5They say: 'What you have said — so be it,
[but] truly the desire to see Krishna has arisen in us.'

তবে সাধু ক্রোধ করি দোঁহারে বলে ।
তোরা কৃষ্ণ দেখ গিয়া আমি থাকি ঘরে ॥ ৭২+৬ ॥

tabe sādhu krodha kari doṁhāre bale |
torā kṛṣṇa dekha giẏā āmi thāki ghare || 72+6 ||

tabe sadhu — then the merchant; krodha kari — in anger; donhare bale — says to both; tora krishna dekha giya — go and see Krishna; ami thaki ghare — I stay at home

72+6Then the merchant angrily says to them both:
'Go and see Krishna, and I will stay at home.'

শুনি দুই স্ত্রী হইল দুঃখিত অন্তরে ।
পতি ছাড়ি কৃষ্ণ ভজি এই সে বিচারে ॥ ৭২+৭ ॥

śuni dui strī haila duḥkhita antare |
pati chāṛi kṛṣṇa bhaji ei se bicāre || 72+7 ||

shuni — hearing; dui stri haila duhkhita antare — the two wives were sad at heart; pati chhari — leaving the husband; krishna bhaji — let us serve Krishna; ei se vichare — so they resolved

72+7Hearing this, both wives were sad at heart
and resolved: 'We will leave our husband and serve Krishna.'

চলিলা সুন্দরী তারা পতিরে ছাড়িয়া ।
দয়া হৈল গোবিন্দের একান্ত দেখিয়া ॥ ৭২+৮ ॥

calilā sundarī tārā patire chāṛiẏā |
daẏā haila gobindera ekānta dekhiẏā || 72+8 ||

chalila sundari tara — those beautiful women went; patire chhariya — leaving the husband; daya haila govindera — Govinda felt mercy; ekanta dekhiya — seeing their exclusive devotion

72+8The beautiful women went, leaving their husband;
Govinda was filled with mercy, seeing their devotion.

সাধুর হৃদয়ে প্রভু সঞ্চারিলা দয়া ।
স্ত্রীয়েরে দেখয়ে সাধু তবে সে আসিয়া ॥ ৭২+৯ ॥

sādhura hṛdaẏe prabhu sañcārilā daẏā |
strīẏere dekhaẏe sādhu tabe se āsiẏā || 72+9 ||

sadhura hridaye — in the merchant's heart; prabhu sancharila daya — the Lord infused mercy; striyere dekhaye sadhu — the merchant sees the wives; tabe se asiya — then, coming

72+9The Lord awakened mercy in the merchant's heart,
and the merchant, coming, sees his wives:

ধিক্ ধিক্ আমি ছার পাপিষ্ঠ-হৃদয় ।
হেন স্ত্রীয়ে অসম্মান যুক্তি ভাল নয় ॥ ৭২+১০ ॥

dhik dhik āmi chāra pāpiṣṭha-hṛdaẏa |
hena strīẏe asammāna yukti bhāla naẏa || 72+10 ||

dhik dhik — shame, shame; ami chhara — I, worthless; papishtha-hridaya — sinful at heart; hena striye asammana — such dishonour to wives; yukti bhala naya — is not right

72+10'Shame, shame on me, worthless and sinful at heart!
It is not right to dishonour such wives.'

সাধু বলে চল সঙ্গে লব তো সবারে ।
পরম পবিত্র তোরা পুণ্য-কলেবরে ॥ ৭২+১১ ॥

sādhu bale cala saṅge laba to sabāre |
parama pabitra torā puṇya-kalebare || 72+11 ||

sadhu bale — the merchant says; chala — come; sange laba to sabare — I will take you along; parama pavitra tora — you are utterly pure; punya-kalebare — holy in body

72+11The merchant says: 'Come, I will take you with me:
you are utterly pure, your bodies are holy.

স্বামীর সৌভাগ্য যার নারী কৃষ্ণব্রত ।
অখিল-পূজিত সেই পরম মহত্ত্ব ॥ ৭২+১২ ॥

sbāmīra saubhāgya yāra nārī kṛṣṇabrata |
akhila-pūjita sei parama mahattba || 72+12 ||

svamira saubhagya — the husband's good fortune; yara nari krishna-vrata — whose wife is vowed to Krishna; akhila-pujita sei — she is honoured by all; parama mahattva — supreme is her worth

72+12If a wife is devoted to Krishna, it is her husband's good fortune:
she is honoured by all, great is her worth'16.

ঠাকুর দেখিতে সেই আইলা সওদাগর ।
দুই নারী লঞা গেলা মন্দির-ভিতর ॥ ৭৩ ॥

ṭhākura dekhite sei āilā saodāgara |
dui nārī lañā gelā mandira-bhitara || 73 ||

thakura dekhite — to see the Thakura; sei aila saodagara — that merchant came; dui nari lanya — with two wives; gela mandira-bhitara — went into the temple

73To see the Thakura that merchant came,
with his two wives he went into the temple.

প্রভু নমস্করি' সাধু ভৈগেল বাহিরে ।
সাধু বাহির হৈল দ্বার লাগিল মন্দিরে ॥ ৭৪ ॥

prabhu namaskari' sādhu bhaigela bāhire |
sādhu bāhira haila dbāra lāgila mandire || 74 ||

prabhu namaskari — bowing to the Lord; sadhu bhaigela bahire — the merchant went out; sadhu bahira haila — the merchant came out; dvara lagila mandire — the temple doors closed

74Bowing to the Lord, the merchant went outside;
the merchant went out — and the temple doors closed.

লেউটিয়া দেখে দুই নারী নাই পাশে ।
মন্দির-ভিতরে তারা প্রভুকে সম্ভাষে ॥ ৭৫ ॥

leuṭiẏā dekhe dui nārī nāi pāśe |
mandira-bhitare tārā prabhuke sambhāṣe || 75 ||

leutiya dekhe — turning back, he sees; dui nari nai pashe — the two wives are not beside him; mandira-bhitare tara — they are inside the temple; prabhuke sambhashe — speaking with the Lord

75Turning back, he sees — the two wives are not beside him:
they are inside the temple, conversing with the Lord.

বুঝিয়া সে সাধু স্তব করে আর্তনাদে ।
দ্রবিলা ঠাকুর তারে কৈলা পরসাদে ॥ ৭৬ ॥

bujhiẏā se sādhu staba kare ārtanāde |
drabilā ṭhākura tāre kailā parasāde || 76 ||

bujhiya se sadhu — understanding, the merchant; stava kare artanade — praises with laments; dravila thakura — the Thakura melted; tare kaila parasade — showed him grace

76Understanding this, the merchant offers praises with laments;
the Thakura relented and showed him grace.

ঘুচিল মন্দির-দ্বার দেখে দুইজন ।
পাষাণ হইয়া প্রভুর পাঞাছে চরণ ॥ ৭৭ ॥

ghucila mandira-dbāra dekhe duijana |
pāṣāṇa haiẏā prabhura pāñāche caraṇa || 77 ||

ghuchila mandira-dvara — the temple door opened; dekhe duijana — he sees: the two; pashana haiya — turning to stone; prabhura panyachhe charana — have attained the Lord's feet

77The temple doors opened — he sees: both
have turned to stone and attained the Lord's feet.

পতি ছাড়ি কৃষ্ণপতি লভিবারে গেল ।
সে কারণে কৃষ্ণপতি সুদৃঢ় পাইল ॥ ৭৭+১ ॥

pati chāṛi kṛṣṇapati labhibāre gela |
se kāraṇe kṛṣṇapati sudṛṛha pāila || 77+1 ||

pati chhari — leaving the husband; krishna-pati labhibare gela — went to attain Krishna as Husband; se karane — therefore; krishna-pati sudridha paila — attained Krishna as steadfast Husband

77+1They went, leaving their husband, to attain Krishna as Husband —
therefore they attained Krishna as their steadfast Husband17.

নিজভাগ্য মানি' পায়ে পড়ে সওদাগর ।
পরসাদ করি' প্রভু বোলে মাগ বর ॥ ৭৮ ॥

nijabhāgya māni' pāẏe paṛe saodāgara |
parasāda kari' prabhu bole māga bara || 78 ||

nija-bhagya mani — deeming it his fortune; paye pare saodagara — the merchant falls at the feet; parasada kari — showing grace; prabhu bole maga bara — the Lord says: "Ask a boon"

78Deeming this his good fortune, the merchant fell at [the Lord's] feet;
showing grace, the Lord says: 'Ask a boon.'

চরণে পড়িয়া সাধু করে পরণাম ।
বর মাগে মোর নামে হউ তোর নাম ॥ ৭৯ ॥

caraṇe paṛiẏā sādhu kare paraṇāma |
bara māge mora nāme hau tora nāma || 79 ||

charane pariya — falling at the feet; sadhu kare paranama — the merchant bows; bara mage — asks a boon; mora name hau tora nama — let Your name be after my name

79Falling at His feet, the merchant bows
and asks a boon: 'Let Your name be after my name.

মা-বাপে থুইল মোর এ নাম জীয়ড় ।
আপনার নামে প্রভু-নাম মাগে বর ॥ ৮০ ॥

mā-bāpe thuila mora e nāma jīẏaṛa |
āpanāra nāme prabhu-nāma māge bara || 80 ||

ma-bape thuila — mother and father gave; mora e nama jiyada — me this name "Jiyada"; apanara name — after his own name; prabhu-nama mage bara — asks as a boon a name for the Lord

80My father and mother gave me the name "Jiyada"' —
so after his own name he asks as a boon a name for the Lord.

জীয়ড়-নৃসিংহ নাম তেঞি পরকাশ ।
আনন্দে কহয়ে গুণ এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৮১ ॥

jīẏaṛa-nṛsiṃha nāma teñi parakāśa |
ānande kahaẏe guṇa e locanadāsa || 81 ||

jiyada-nrisimha nama — the name "Jiyada-Nrisimha"; tenyi parakasha — therefore became known; anande kahaye guna — joyfully tells the glories; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

81Therefore the name "Jiyada-Nrisimha" became renowned"18.
In joy this Lochana Dasa sings [His] glories.

Raga sindhura

তবে মহাপ্রভু জীয়ড়-নৃসিংহ দেখিয়া ।
চলিলা ত পরদিনে সে দিন বঞ্চিয়া ॥ ৮২ ॥

tabe mahāprabhu jīẏaṛa-nṛsiṃha dekhiẏā |
calilā ta paradine se dina bañciẏā || 82 ||

tabe — then; mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu; jiyada-nrisimha dekhiya — having seen Jiyada-Nrisimha; chalila ta — set out; paradine — on the next day; se dina vanchiya — having spent that day

82Then Mahaprabhu, having seen Jiyada-Nrisimha
and spent that day there, set out on the next day.

চলি' যায় পথে প্রেম-পরবশ-চিত ।
কাঞ্চী-নগরে প্রভু ভেল উপনীত ॥ ৮৩ ॥

cali' yāẏa pathe prema-parabaśa-cita |
kāñcī-nagare prabhu bhela upanīta || 83 ||

chali yaya pathe — goes along the road; prema-parabasha-chita — His heart in the power of prema; kanchi-nagare — to the town of Kanchi; prabhu bhela upanita — the Lord arrived

83He walks along the road, His heart in the power of prema;
the Lord arrived at the town of Kanchi19.

রত্নময় পুরী সেই কাঞ্চীনগর ।
নগর দেখিয়া তুষ্ট হৈল ন্যাসিবর ॥ ৮৪ ॥

ratnamaẏa purī sei kāñcīnagara |
nagara dekhiẏā tuṣṭa haila nyāsibara || 84 ||

ratnamaya puri — a city full of jewels; sei kanchinagara — that Kanchi-nagara; nagara dekhiya — seeing the town; tushta haila — was pleased; nyasivara — the best of sannyasis

84Kanchi-nagara is a town full of jewels;
seeing the town, the best of sannyasis was pleased.

বিষয়ীর মুখ প্রভু নাহি দেখে কভু ।
আচম্বিতে রাজদ্বারে উত্তরিলা প্রভু ॥ ৮৫ ॥

biṣaẏīra mukha prabhu nāhi dekhe kabhu |
ācambite rājadbāre uttarilā prabhu || 85 ||

vishayira mukha — the faces of worldly men; prabhu nahi dekhe kabhu — the Lord never looks at; achambite — suddenly; rajadvare uttarila prabhu — the Lord came to the king's gate

85Never does the Lord look on the faces of worldly men —
[and yet] the Lord suddenly came to the king's gate.

রাজা গোদাবরী স্নান করি' বিপ্র সঙ্গে ।
অন্তঃপুরে আসি' কৃষ্ণসেবা করে রঙ্গে ॥ ৮৫+১ ॥

rājā godābarī snāna kari' bipra saṅge |
antaḥpure āsi' kṛṣṇasebā kare raṅge || 85+1 ||

raja — the king; godavari snana kari — having bathed in the Godavari; vipra sange — with the brahmanas; antahpure asi — coming to the inner apartments; krishna-seva kare range — joyfully serves Krishna

85+1The king, having bathed in the Godavari with the brahmanas,
came to his inner apartments and joyfully serves Krishna.

প্রভু আসি' হেনকালে দ্বারে আগমন ।
পরম সুন্দর কান্তি মদনমোহন ॥ ৮৫+২ ॥

prabhu āsi' henakāle dbāre āgamana |
parama sundara kānti madanamohana || 85+2 ||

prabhu asi — the Lord, coming; henakale — at this time; dvare agamana — arrival at the gate; parama sundara kanti — supremely beautiful radiance; madana-mohana — enchanter of Madana

85+2At that time the Lord came to the gate —
His radiance supremely beautiful, the enchanter of Madana20.

রাজার দুয়ারে গিয়া দ্বারীকে কহিল ।
রাজপুত্র কোথা আছে নিভৃতে পুছিল ॥ ৮৬ ॥

rājāra duẏāre giẏā dbārīke kahila |
rājaputra kothā āche nibhṛte puchila || 86 ||

rajara duyare giya — going to the king's gate; dvarike kahila — spoke to the doorkeeper; rajaputra kotha achhe — where is the prince; nibhrite puchhila — asked quietly

86Coming to the king's gate, He spoke to the doorkeeper
and quietly asked: "Where is the prince?"21

প্রভুকে দেখিয়া দ্বারী পরণাম করে ।
এই ভগবান্ হেন মনে মনে বোলে ॥ ৮৭ ॥

prabhuke dekhiẏā dbārī paraṇāma kare |
ei bhagabān hena mane mane bole || 87 ||

prabhuke dekhiya — seeing the Lord; dvari paranama kare — the doorkeeper bows; ei bhagavan — this is Bhagavan; hena — thus; mane mane bole — says within himself

87Seeing the Lord, the doorkeeper bows
and says within himself: "This is Bhagavan."

প্রভু কহে রাজপুত্রে জানাহ বচন ।
তাহার নিমিত্তে মোর এথা আগমন ॥ ৮৮ ॥

prabhu kahe rājaputre jānāha bacana |
tāhāra nimitte mora ethā āgamana || 88 ||

prabhu kahe — the Lord says; rajaputre janaha vachana — give the prince the message; tahara nimitte — for his sake; mora etha agamana — My coming here

88The Lord says: "Give the prince a message:
it is for his sake that I have come here."

চলিল ত দ্বারী রাজপুত্র যথা আছে ।
নিজ অন্তঃপুরে যথা দেবতা পূজিছে ॥ ৮৯ ॥

calila ta dbārī rājaputra yathā āche |
nija antaḥpure yathā debatā pūjiche || 89 ||

chalila ta dvari — the doorkeeper went; rajaputra yatha achhe — where the prince is; nija antahpure — in his own inner apartments; yatha devata pujichhe — where he is worshipping the Deity

89The doorkeeper went to where the prince was —
to his inner apartments, where he was worshipping the Deity.

প্রণাম করি' দ্বারী জানায় বচন ।
এক মহামতি গোসাঞি দ্বারে আগমন ॥ ৯০ ॥

praṇāma kari' dbārī jānāẏa bacana |
eka mahāmati gosāñi dbāre āgamana || 90 ||

pranama kari — bowing; dvari janaya vachana — the doorkeeper gives the message; eka mahamati gosani — a gosani of great spirit; dvare agamana — has come to the gate

90Bowing, the doorkeeper gives the message:
"A gosani of great spirit has come to the gate."

এ বোল শুনিঞা রাজা না বলিল কিছু ।
তরাসে দ্বারী সে পলাইয়া যায় পাছু ॥ ৯১ ॥

e bola śuniñā rājā nā balila kichu |
tarāse dbārī se palāiẏā yāẏa pāchu || 91 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing these words; raja na balila kichhu — the king said nothing; tarase — in fear; dvari se palaiya yaya pachhu — the doorkeeper drew back

91Hearing this, the king said nothing,
and the doorkeeper in fear drew back.

দ্বারেতে আসিয়া দ্বারী করে নিবেদন ।
জানাইতে না পারিল তোমার বচন ॥ ৯২ ॥

dbārete āsiẏā dbārī kare nibedana |
jānāite nā pārila tomāra bacana || 92 ||

dvarete asiya — coming to the gate; dvari kare nivedana — the doorkeeper reports; janaite na parila — could not deliver; tomara vachana — Your message

92Returning to the gate, the doorkeeper reports:
"I could not deliver Your message.

দেবতা পূজয়ে রাজা নিজ অন্তঃপুরে ।
কাহার শকতি তথা যাইবারে পারে ॥ ৯৩ ॥

debatā pūjaẏe rājā nija antaḥpure |
kāhāra śakati tathā yāibāre pāre || 93 ||

devata pujaye raja — the king worships the Deity; nija antahpure — in his inner apartments; kahara shakati — whose power; tatha yaibare pare — can go there

93The king is worshipping the Deity in his inner apartments —
who has the power to go in there?"

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভু হাসে মনে মনে ।
যথা পূজা করে তথা চলিলা আপনে ॥ ৯৪ ॥

e bola śuniẏā prabhu hāse mane mane |
yathā pūjā kare tathā calilā āpane || 94 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing this; prabhu hase mane mane — the Lord smiles within Himself; yatha puja kare — where [he] worships; tatha chalila apane — there He went Himself

94Hearing this, the Lord smiles within Himself
and went Himself to where [the king] is worshipping.

এক-অংশে দ্বারে রহে আর অংশে যায় ।
যথা পূজা করে সেই রামানন্দ রায় ॥ ৯৫ ॥

eka-aṃśe dbāre rahe āra aṃśe yāẏa |
yathā pūjā kare sei rāmānanda rāẏa || 95 ||

eka-amshe — with one portion; dvare rahe — stays at the gate; ara amshe yaya — with another goes; yatha puja kare — where performs worship; sei ramananda raya — that Ramananda Raya

95With one portion of Himself He stays at the gate, with another He goes
to where Ramananda Raya is worshipping22.

ধ্যান করয়ে কৃষ্ণ দেখে গৌরচন্দ্র ।
পুনরপি ধ্যান করে জপে মহামন্ত্র ॥ ৯৬ ॥

dhyāna karaẏe kṛṣṇa dekhe gauracandra |
punarapi dhyāna kare jape mahāmantra || 96 ||

dhyana karaye krishna — meditates on Krishna; dekhe gaurachandra — sees Gaurachandra; punarapi dhyana kare — again meditates; jape mahamantra — chants the great mantra

96[Ramananda] meditates on Krishna — and sees Gaurachandra;
again he meditates, chanting the great mantra —

পুনরপি সেই গৌর দেখয়ে নয়নে ।
কি হৈল কি হৈল বলি' গুণে মনে মনে ॥ ৯৭ ॥

punarapi sei gaura dekhaẏe naẏane |
ki haila ki haila bali' guṇe mane mane || 97 ||

punarapi — again; sei gaura dekhaye nayane — sees that Gaura with his eyes; ki haila ki haila bali — saying "what is this? what is this?"; gune mane mane — ponders within himself

97and again he sees that same Gaura before his eyes.
"What is this? What is this?" he wonders within himself.

পুনরপি ধ্যান করে সুদৃঢ়-হিয়ায় ।
পুনরপি গৌরচন্দ্র হিয়ায় সান্ধায় ॥ ৯৮ ॥

punarapi dhyāna kare sudṛṛha-hiẏāẏa |
punarapi gauracandra hiẏāẏa sāndhāẏa || 98 ||

punarapi dhyana kare — again he meditates; sudridha-hiyaya — with a firm heart; punarapi gaurachandra — again Gaurachandra; hiyaya sandhaya — enters the heart

98Again he meditates with a steadfast heart —
and again Gaurachandra enters his heart.

কি কি বলি' আঁখি মেলি' চাহে চারিভিতে ।
গৌরচন্দ্র ন্যাসিবর দেখে আচম্বিতে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

ki ki bali' āṁkhi meli' cāhe cāribhite |
gauracandra nyāsibara dekhe ācambite || 99 ||

ki ki bali — saying "what? what?"; ankhi meli — opening his eyes; chahe charibhite — looks all around; gaurachandra nyasivara — Gaurachandra, best of sannyasis; dekhe achambite — suddenly sees

99"What? What?" he says, opens his eyes and looks all around —
and suddenly sees Gaurachandra, the best of sannyasis23.

সন্ন্যাসী দেখিয়া রাজা উঠিলা সম্ভ্রমে ।
চরণবন্দনা করি' নেহারয়ে ক্রমে ॥ ১০০ ॥

sannyāsī dekhiẏā rājā uṭhilā sambhrame |
caraṇabandanā kari' nehāraẏe krame || 100 ||

sannyasi dekhiya — seeing the sannyasi; raja uthila sambhrame — the king rose in awe; charana-vandana kari — bowing to the feet; neharaye krame — gazes unhurriedly

100Seeing the sannyasi, the king rose in awe,
bowed at His feet and gazes at [Him] unhurriedly.

আপাদ-মস্তক প্রভুর নেহারয়ে অঙ্গ ।
গৌর-অঙ্গ দেখি' হিয়ায় উপজিল রঙ্গ ॥ ১০১ ॥

āpāda-mastaka prabhura nehāraẏe aṅga |
gaura-aṅga dekhi' hiẏāẏa upajila raṅga || 101 ||

apada-mastaka — from foot to head; prabhura neharaye anga — gazes at the Lord's body; gaura-anga dekhi — seeing the golden body; hiyaya upajila ranga — joy arose in his heart

101From head to foot he gazes at the Lord's body;
seeing the golden body, joy arose in his heart.

বিস্ময় লাগিল ন্যাসী আইলা কেমতে ।
প্রভুরে কহয়ে কিছু হাসিতে হাসিতে ॥ ১০২ ॥

bismaẏa lāgila nyāsī āilā kemate |
prabhure kahaẏe kichu hāsite hāsite || 102 ||

vismaya lagila — amazement seized him; nyasi aila kemate — how did the sannyasi come; prabhure kahaye kichhu — says something to the Lord; hasite hasite — smiling

102He was amazed: how did the sannyasi come in?
Smiling, he says to the Lord:

মোর অভ্যন্তরে তুমি আইলা কেমনে ।
বড়ভাগ্যে দেখিলাম তোমার চরণে ॥ ১০৩ ॥

mora abhyantare tumi āilā kemane |
baṛabhāgye dekhilāma tomāra caraṇe || 103 ||

mora abhyantare — into my apartments; tumi aila kemane — how did You come; bada-bhagye — by great fortune; dekhilama tomara charane — I have seen Your feet

103"How did You enter my apartments?
By great fortune I have seen Your feet."

প্রভু কহে তুমি কেনে না চিন আপনা ।
আমারে না চিন আমি নিতে আইলুঁ তোমা ॥ ১০৪ ॥

prabhu kahe tumi kene nā cina āpanā |
āmāre nā cina āmi nite āiluṁ tomā || 104 ||

prabhu kahe — the Lord says; tumi kene na china apana — why do you not know yourself; amare na china — you do not know Me; ami nite ailun toma — I have come to take you

104The Lord says: "Why do you not know your own self?
You do not recognize Me — and I have come to take you."

এইরূপে বোলে প্রভু মধুর বচনে ।
আমারে না চিন আমি নন্দের নন্দনে ॥ ১০৪+১ ॥

eirūpe bole prabhu madhura bacane |
āmāre nā cina āmi nandera nandane || 104+1 ||

ei-rupe — thus; bole prabhu — the Lord speaks; madhura vachane — in sweet words; amare na china — you do not know Me; ami nandera nandane — I am the son of Nanda

104+1Thus the Lord speaks in sweet words:
"You do not recognize Me — I am the son of Nanda."

এ বোল শুনিয়া রাজা ছলছল আঁখি ।
সেইরূপ দেখাও তবে হিয়া পায় সাক্ষী ॥ ১০৪+২ ॥

e bola śuniẏā rājā chalachala āṁkhi |
seirūpa dekhāo tabe hiẏā pāẏa sākṣī || 104+2 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing this; raja chhalachhala ankhi — the king, eyes brimming; seirupa dekhao — show that form; tabe hiya paya sakshi — then the heart will have a witness

104+2Hearing this, the king, his eyes brimming with tears, [says]:
"Then show me that form — so my heart will have a witness"24.

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু অট্ট অট্ট হাস ।
আপনা চিনায় প্রভু করে পরকাশ ॥ ১০৫ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu aṭṭa aṭṭa hāsa |
āpanā cināẏa prabhu kare parakāśa || 105 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu atta atta hasa — the Lord laughed aloud; apana chinaya — makes Himself known; prabhu kare parakasha — the Lord reveals [Himself]

105Hearing this, the Lord laughed aloud;
the Lord makes Himself known and reveals Himself.

যে ছিল সেখানে কৃষ্ণ-শ্বেত-রক্ত-দ্যুতি ।
সকল দেখায় এক গৌর-মূরতি ॥ ১০৬ ॥

ye chila sekhāne kṛṣṇa-śbeta-rakta-dyuti |
sakala dekhāẏa eka gaura-mūrati || 106 ||

ye chhila sekhane — whatever was there; krishna-shveta-rakta-dyuti — of dark, white, red hue; sakala dekhaya — all appears; eka gaura-murati — as one golden form

106All that was there — dark, white, red —
everything appears as one golden form.

কষিত এ দশবাণ কাঞ্চন-বরণ ।
তাহা ছাড়ি' হৈলা প্রভু শ্যাম-সুচিক্কণ ॥ ১০৭ ॥

kaṣita e daśabāṇa kāñcana-baraṇa |
tāhā chāṛi' hailā prabhu śyāma-sucikkaṇa || 107 ||

kashita — tested [on the touchstone]; e dashabana kanchana-varana — this colour of gold of "ten-fold" purity; taha chhari — leaving it; haila prabhu — the Lord became; shyama-suchikkana — dark and glossy

107That colour of tested, purest gold
the Lord gave up — and became dark and glossy.

কানড়া-কুসুমাকৃতি অঙ্গের বরণ ।
ময়ূর-শিখণ্ড শিরে মুরলীবদন ॥ ১০৮ ॥

kānaṛā-kusumākṛti aṅgera baraṇa |
maẏūra-śikhaṇḍa śire muralībadana || 108 ||

kanada-kusumakriti — like the kanada flower; angera varana — the colour of the body; mayura-shikhanda shire — a peacock feather on the head; murali-vadana — a flute at the lips

108His body has the colour of the kanada flower,
a peacock feather on His head, a flute at His lips.

নানা আভরণ অঙ্গে চিকণিয়া কালা ।
পীতবস্ত্র পরিধান গলে বনমালা ॥ ১০৯ ॥

nānā ābharaṇa aṅge cikaṇiẏā kālā |
pītabastra paridhāna gale banamālā || 109 ||

nana abharana ange — various ornaments on the body; chikaniya kala — lustrous black; pita-vastra paridhana — dressed in yellow garments; gale vanamala — a forest garland on the neck

109Various ornaments on His body, He is lustrous black,
dressed in yellow garments, a forest garland on His neck.

তাহা দেখি' মহারাজ আনন্দিত মন ।
পুনরপি হৈলা প্রভু গৌরবরণ ॥ ১১০ ॥

tāhā dekhi' mahārāja ānandita mana |
punarapi hailā prabhu gaurabaraṇa || 110 ||

taha dekhi — seeing this; maharaja anandita mana — the maharaja rejoices at heart; punarapi — again; haila prabhu gaura-varana — the Lord became golden in colour

110Seeing this, the maharaja rejoiced at heart,
and the Lord became golden once more25.

পশু পক্ষী বৃক্ষ আর যত লতা পাতা ।
গৌর-অঙ্গ-ছটায় ঝলমল করে তথা ॥ ১১১ ॥

paśu pakṣī bṛkṣa āra yata latā pātā |
gaura-aṅga-chaṭāẏa jhalamala kare tathā || 111 ||

pashu pakshi vriksha — beasts, birds, trees; ara yata lata pata — and all creepers and leaves; gaura-anga-chhataya — in the radiance of the golden body; jhalamala kare tatha — glitter there

111Beasts, birds, trees, and all the creepers and leaves
glitter there in the radiance of the golden body.

দেখিয়া জানিল কাজ রামানন্দ রায় ।
প্রেমায় বিহ্বল ধরে নিজ-প্রভু-পায় ॥ ১১২ ॥

dekhiẏā jānila kāja rāmānanda rāẏa |
premāẏa bihbala dhare nija-prabhu-pāẏa || 112 ||

dekhiya — seeing; janila kaja — understood the matter; ramananda raya — Ramananda Raya; premaya vihvala — overcome with prema; dhare nija-prabhu-paya — clasps the feet of his Lord

112Seeing this, Ramananda Raya understood what it was:
overcome with prema, he clasped the feet of his Lord.

পুনর্বার হৈলা প্রভু শ্যাম-কলেবর ।
ত্রিভঙ্গ মুরলীমুখ পীতাম্বরধর ॥ ১১২+১ ॥

punarbāra hailā prabhu śyāma-kalebara |
tribhaṅga muralīmukha pītāmbaradhara || 112+1 ||

punarvara — again; haila prabhu shyama-kalevara — the Lord took a dark body; tribhanga — thrice-bent; murali-mukha — a flute at His lips; pitambara-dhara — wearing yellow garments

112+1Again the Lord took a dark body —
thrice-bent, a flute at His lips, wearing yellow garments.

রাধা বামে পরমা সুন্দরী মহাজ্যোতি ।
চৌদিকে বেড়িয়া গোপী বরাঙ্গ-যুবতী ॥ ১১২+২ ॥

rādhā bāme paramā sundarī mahājyoti |
caudike beṛiẏā gopī barāṅga-yubatī || 112+2 ||

radha vame — Radha on the left; parama sundari — a supreme beauty; maha-jyoti — a great radiance; chaudike bediya — surrounding on all sides; gopi varanga-yuvati — the gopis, young maidens of lovely form

112+2On His left is Radha, a supreme beauty, a great radiance;
all around are the gopis, young maidens of lovely form.

বৃন্দাবনে রতন-মন্দির-সিংহাসনে ।
দেখে রাজা পরম আনন্দ রাধা-সনে ॥ ১১২+৩ ॥

bṛndābane ratana-mandira-siṃhāsane |
dekhe rājā parama ānanda rādhā-sane || 112+3 ||

vrindavane — in Vrindavana; ratana-mandira-simhasane — on a throne in a jewelled temple; dekhe raja — the king sees; parama ananda — supreme bliss; radha-sane — with Radha

112+3In Vrindavana, in a temple of jewels, on a throne,
the king sees [Him] — supreme bliss — with Radha.

পুনর্বার হৈলা প্রভু গৌরাঙ্গ-মূরতি ।
অরুণ-অম্বর অঙ্গে যেন মহামতি ॥ ১১২+৪ ॥

punarbāra hailā prabhu gaurāṅga-mūrati |
aruṇa-ambara aṅge yena mahāmati || 112+4 ||

punarvara — again; haila prabhu gauranga-murati — the Lord took the golden form; aruna-ambara ange — red garments on the body; yena mahamati — like a great sage

112+4Again the Lord took on His golden form —
red garments on His body, as on a great sage26.

চরণে পড়িয়া কান্দে অবশ শরীর ।
করে ধরি' লঞা প্রভু ভৈ গেলা বাহির ॥ ১১৩ ॥

caraṇe paṛiẏā kānde abaśa śarīra |
kare dhari' lañā prabhu bhai gelā bāhira || 113 ||

charane pariya — falling at the feet; kande — weeps; abasha sharira — body powerless; kare dhari — taking by the hand; lanya prabhu — the Lord, taking [him]; bhai gela bahira — went outside

113Fallen at [His] feet, [Ramananda] weeps, his body powerless;
taking him by the hand, the Lord went outside [with him].

এ প্রকাশ দেখিল সে রাজা আচম্বিত ।
দশদিন ছিল প্রভু রাজার সহিত ॥ ১১৩+১ ॥

e prakāśa dekhila se rājā ācambita |
daśadina chila prabhu rājāra sahita || 113+1 ||

e prakasha — this manifestation; dekhila se raja — the king beheld; achambita — unexpectedly; dashadina chhila prabhu — ten days the Lord stayed; rajara sahita — with the king

113+1Such a manifestation the king beheld unexpectedly;
ten days the Lord stayed with the king.

অনেক হৈল কৃষ্ণকথা তার সনে ।
বিস্তারি' কহিতে তাহা অনন্ত না জানে ॥ ১১৩+২ ॥

aneka haila kṛṣṇakathā tāra sane |
bistāri' kahite tāhā ananta nā jāne || 113+2 ||

aneka haila krishna-katha — there were many talks about Krishna; tara sane — with him; vistari kahite taha — to tell them in full; ananta na jane — Ananta does not know [how]

113+2Many were their talks about Krishna;
even Ananta does not know how to retell them in full.

অনন্ত চৈতন্যলীলা বেদ-অগোচর ।
কোনো লীলা কোনো ভক্ত করেন বিস্তার ॥ ১১৩+৩ ॥

ananta caitanyalīlā beda-agocara |
kono līlā kono bhakta karena bistāra || 113+3 ||

ananta chaitanya-lila — endless are the lilas of Chaitanya; veda-agochara — beyond the reach of the Vedas; kono lila — some lila; kono bhakta karena vistara — some devotee describes at length

113+3Endless are the lilas of Chaitanya, beyond the reach of the Vedas;
some lila one devotee or another describes at length.

আদ্যোপান্ত কহিতে শকতি আছে কার ।
লিখিতে লিখিতে গ্রন্থ হয় ত বিস্তার ॥ ১১৩+৪ ॥

ādyopānta kahite śakati āche kāra |
likhite likhite grantha haẏa ta bistāra || 113+4 ||

adyopanta kahite — to tell from beginning to end; shakati achhe kara — who has the power; likhite likhite — as one writes and writes; grantha haya ta vistara — the book grows

113+4Who has the power to tell everything from beginning to end?
As one writes and writes, the book only grows27.

রায় রামানন্দে আর প্রভুতে মিলন ।
গোরা-গুণগাথা গায় এ দাস লোচন ॥ ১১৪ ॥

rāẏa rāmānande āra prabhute milana |
gorā-guṇagāthā gāẏa e dāsa locana || 114 ||

raya ramanande ara prabhute milana — the meeting of Ramananda Raya and the Lord; gora-guna-gatha — the song of Gora's virtues; gaya — sings; e dasa lochana — this Lochana Dasa

114The meeting of Ramananda Raya and the Lord —
a song of the virtues of Gora; this Lochana Dasa sings it.

✦

Notes

  1. Rasaraja ("king of rasa", Krishna) and Mahabhava (Radha) in one form. According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 8), at the end of the talks on the Godavari the Lord showed Ramananda just this form; in Lochana Dasa (vv. 105–110) the Lord shows the form of Krishna, and in the 1983 edition Krishna with Radha.
  2. On Narahari and Gadadhara see en/24, v. 1. In the 1983 edition the Shesha-khanda is divided into chapters; chapter 1 bears the same title as Bhaktisiddhanta's section: "The Lord's Journey to the South."
  3. Kurma-kshetra (Shrikurmam) is a shrine of Vishnu in the form of the Tortoise on the coast south of Orissa. Vv. 3–14 — cf. Murari 3.13–3.14.13–20 and the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 7): the brahmana Kurma receives the Lord at his home, and the leper brahmana Vasudeva is healed by His embrace. Lochana Dasa does not mention leprosy; "became pure" (v. 6) may hint at the healing.
  4. Cf. Murari 3.14.19 and the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 7.128): "Whomever you meet, instruct him about Krishna."
  5. Jiyada-Nrisimha is the Deity of Varaha-Nrisimha at Simhachalam, near Vishakhapatnam. The Lord tells the tale of this Deity (vv. 16–81) also in Murari (3.14.21–32), more briefly; in the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 8) the Lord only visits Him.
  6. "Punda" — in Murari (3.14.23) "Pundaya"; it may be not a name but the name of a caste. The words "shasa" (in the 1983 edition "shasha", apparently cucumbers) and "mayambu" (so too in Murari) are unclear; they are given as they read.
  7. Vv. 22+1 — 22+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. The 1983 edition reads the second line of v. 22: "To whom shall I entrust the guarding of the crop?"
  8. Vv. 23+1 — 23+3 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript.
  9. The boar is the Lord Himself in the form of Varaha; by the name of Rama which He utters the cowherd recognizes Bhagavan (v. 30). Cf. Murari 3.14.24–25.
  10. The sense of the first line is not quite clear; we understand: "you wounded Me, and I ate your crop — we are quits."
  11. Vv. 41+1 — 41+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript.
  12. Vv. 42+1 — 42+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them partly in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. "Your body is My body" are words of the Lord's love for His devotee (cf. Bhagavata 9.4.68: "The sadhus are My heart, and I am their heart"), not a doctrine of the identity of the soul and God.
  13. Vv. 59+1 — 59+5 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. The thought that a devotee is not judged by birth is constant in Lochana Dasa and in all Gaudiya Vaishnavas.
  14. Cf. Murari 3.14.26–28: at the Lord's word the place is sprinkled with milk, and He reveals His form. The body of the Deity rises out of the earth up to the knees; the feet remain hidden.
  15. Vv. 71+1 — 71+4 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript.
  16. Vv. 72+1 — 72+12 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. Cf. the wives of the brahmanas (yajna-patnis) who went to Krishna in spite of their husbands' prohibition (Bhagavata 10.23): devotion to Krishna stands above worldly ties, and a righteous husband accepts it as his good fortune.
  17. V. 77+1 is found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives it only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. The tale of the wives who turned to stone at the feet of the Deity is a local legend; in Murari (3.14.29–30) the merchant comes with one wife, and nothing is said of her fate. Attaining Krishna as Husband (pati) is no worldly bond: Krishna is the true Lord and Beloved of every soul.
  18. So too in Murari (3.14.31–32): the merchant asks that the Lord bear his name — "for Hari is ever subject to His devotees."
  19. So in A and C and in Murari (3.15.1). The 1983 edition reads Vidyanagara (in v. 84 too), as in the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 8), where Ramananda is governor of a province on the Godavari under King Prataparudra, and the Lord meets him on the bank of the Godavari. Kanchi (Kanchipuram) lies much farther south; in Lochana Dasa the Lord only afterwards goes "by way of the Godavari" to Panchavati (v. 116).
  20. Vv. 85+1 — 85+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote (after v. 86), as an additional reading of one manuscript.
  21. Ramananda Raya, son of Bhavananda Raya, was a high nobleman of Orissa; Lochana Dasa calls him now "prince" (rajaputra), now "king".
  22. While remaining at the gate, the Lord at the same time appears to Ramananda in the inner apartments: He can be present in many places at once (cf. Krishna's presence in every palace of Dvaraka, Bhagavata 10.69). "Portion" (amsha) here is not a part cut off from the whole: the Lord is fully present in each of His manifestations.
  23. Vv. 96–99 — cf. Murari 3.15.2–3: having finished his worship of Krishna, Ramananda contemplates the son of the king of Vraja and three times sees the form of Gauranga, and on opening his eyes he sees Him before him.
  24. Vv. 104+1 — 104+2 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript and of a printed edition. In Murari (3.15.4) the Lord says: "How is it that you do not remember, O bee at the lotus feet of Sri Radhika?"
  25. The 1903 edition gives vv. 107–110 only in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript and of a printed edition. The kanada flower is apparently a dark-blue flower (commelina) to which Krishna's colour is compared. According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 8), Ramananda first sees the Lord as a dark cowherd boy, and then the Lord reveals to him the form of Rasaraja and Mahabhava — Krishna and Radha in one body.
  26. Vv. 112+1 — 112+4 are found only in the 1983 edition; the 1903 edition gives them in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript (with one more couplet about the weeping queens). The vision of Radha and Krishna on a throne in the jewelled temple of Vrindavana is a vision of the eternal, transcendental lila of the Divine Couple. Red garments are the garments of a sannyasi.
  27. Vv. 113+1 — 113+4 are found only in the 1983 edition; they are absent from the 1903 edition. In the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 8) the Lord likewise spends several days and nights with Ramananda in talks about Krishna, and Krishnadasa Kaviraja relates these talks in detail.
